body: 'list' hides claimed and blocked tickets by default, which makes a "not closed or rejected" filter feel necessary. Change the default of 'list' and 'labels' to open+claimed+blocked, sorted as before, state shown per line. '-s open' keeps the narrow view, '-a' still means everything, 'unblocked' still means ready. Behaviour change: callers that treated 'list' as claimable work now also see claimed/blocked tickets; release-note item. Update README, SKILL.md, tests.
title: list and labels default to all non-terminal states (open, claimed, blocked)
